2026-07-26 convergence update:

(1) cookiesync v0.27.3 RELEASED — the 12th and final downstream; the fleet is now fully repinned to daemonkit v0.20.6. Release run 30194620784 green (release + publish-tap), tap ac5c1c54, trusted-key tag verified, released tree pins daemonkit v0.20.6 + synckit v0.36.2. One real adaptation: daemonkit 85d53fd's deferred-untrack contract raced two one-shot post-settlement Store.Load sites in cookiesync's bridge tests (3-5/10 flaky) — fixed by bounded polling, recorded in cookiesync cc-notes. Machines may upgrade the cask, but cutover is gated (see 2).

(2) yasyf-home: reposync state migration SUCCEEDED via the amended recipe — audit clean (single known fixable entry), 39 repos listed with both tombstones hidden, new-shape manifest registered, backups intact. NEW BLOCKER: `synckitd install` → `launchctl bootstrap` of com.github.yasyf.synckit.helper.reposync fails `Bootstrap failed: 5: Input/output error` after 6 attempts. Fresh label (never bootstrapped), plist valid, ProgramArguments = versioned Caskroom path /opt/homebrew/Caskroom/reposync/0.27.4/reposync; the agent is now persisted in services.db's Desired set and retries on every controller-open. serve (PID 78035), reconcile, and the old helper.cookiesync (PID 1800) are unaffected; handshake counter frozen at 1224. Diagnosis burst dispatched, quarantine-first: reposync is CASK-distributed (brew quarantines cask artifacts by default) while the agents that bootstrapped fine run the formula-installed, StableProgram-staged synckitd — the sharpest asymmetry. cookiesync cutover on home is GATED on this: same bootstrap path, and it would bootout the working old helper before failing to replace it. If unresolved after the burst, the leg holds like cc-pool/peer-registration.

(3) yasyf box BACK (second WoL recovery, reachable as yasyf@yasyf). box-presweep resumed: verify-first (cc-pool possibly uninstalled mid-window), roster dump before any cc-pool action, staged steps 3-6 with all amendments, and an explicit EIO watch — the box's own `synckitd install` doubles as the cross-machine differential for the home blocker.
